Changelog

Each release leads with one change, then a few fixes.

v2.3.102026-11-11

Nomi and your coding agents can now operate apps on your computer.

  • Install the executor in Settings → Computer Use (agent-desktop, open source from Vercel Labs, Apache-2.0) and grant access, and Nomi can read the UI, click, fill in forms and press shortcuts.
  • Allow once and the rest of that conversation runs on its own; payments, sending and deleting still ask.
  • Claude Code and Codex can open the app and click through it after changing code; stop it any time.
  • Onboarding is three steps and lands on the board.

Fixes

  • Commands can “Always run in this chat”.
  • File diffs are syntax-highlighted.
  • After a coding agent’s first turn fails, the next turn resumes the same session.
  • Task budget interception is gone, so auto-continue no longer stops halfway.

v2.3.92026-11-10

Make your own themes, and view and edit files right in the chat window.

  • “My themes”: pick four colors and get a full theme with contrast fixes.
  • The file side panel previews and edits documents and source code.
  • Choose how much detail each chat shows: compact, thinking, or detailed.

Fixes

  • Changing a project’s folders mid-run takes effect on the next turn (#309).
  • The Agent board can pause Nomi’s background runs.

v2.3.82026-11-09

Workspaces become projects, and a project can hold several folders.

  • Keep a frontend, backend and docs in one project; Nomi and coding agents can read and write all of them.
  • Forking is one dialog, and every reply can be forked from.
  • The Changes panel splits by git repository, each with its own commit.

Fixes

  • Sandboxed coding agents can no longer rewrite version-manager shims (#302).

v2.3.72026-11-09

Kimi Code and MiniMax Code join the built-in coding agents.

  • Both work with official accounts or third-party models.
  • The Agent board closes tabs directly and closes idle processes in bulk.

Fixes

  • Coding agents dispatched by background tasks no longer queue forever (#294).
  • Stale Dynamic Island buttons no longer act on new requests (#293).

v2.3.62026-11-09

Open on the Dynamic Island takes you to the right place.

  • Press Esc to hide the island at any time.
  • Delegations already back in the chat no longer stay “waiting for review”.

v2.3.52026-11-08

The Dynamic Island, Agent board, task board and asset library are redesigned.

  • Allow or deny what is waiting for you right on the island.
  • The board shows what each agent is doing and what it uses.
  • New scheduling modes: saver, balanced, or full speed.

Fixes

  • Reading files in your workspace no longer triggers extra confirmations.

Older releases are on GitHub Releases.
